name: OrderFort Fraud Shield
author: Oltora

sections.description:
OrderFort Fraud Shield helps WooCommerce stores detect suspicious orders, risky customer details, and abusive checkout behavior before they turn into unnecessary admin noise.

It is built for merchants who want practical fraud protection without a heavy setup. The plugin runs inside WordPress and WooCommerce, applies balanced local fraud scoring, and gives store owners useful visibility into suspicious checkout activity while keeping the workflow simple.

Why store owners use OrderFort Fraud Shield

Fake orders, disposable emails, repeated checkout attempts, and suspicious customer behavior can waste time and create friction in WooCommerce order management.

OrderFort Fraud Shield gives stores a lightweight local protection layer designed to work quietly in the background. It helps merchants spot risk faster, review suspicious behavior more clearly, and keep fraud protection easier to manage inside WordPress.

Quick and easy WooCommerce protection

OrderFort Fraud Shield is designed to be easy to install and simple to use.

Once activated, it starts applying balanced local fraud scoring and essential protection checks with minimal setup. The goal is to give store owners a clean starting point for WooCommerce fraud protection without creating a bloated admin workflow.

Core free features

OrderFort Fraud Shield includes:

  • Balanced local fraud scoring for suspicious checkout activity
  • Checkout honeypot protection to help detect automated abuse
  • Disposable email detection for risky customer email patterns
  • Local review and block decisions based on the plugin’s protection logic
  • Per-order risk metadata stored with WooCommerce order data
  • Dashboard visibility for recent activity, IP overview, and recent blocklist data

Built for real WooCommerce stores

OrderFort Fraud Shield is made for merchants who want a practical protection layer inside WordPress.

Whether your store sees occasional fake orders or repeated suspicious checkout attempts, the plugin helps add structure, visibility, and cleaner fraud signals without overcomplicating daily store management.

OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium

The free plugin gives your store a balanced local protection layer.

For stores that need deeper fraud visibility and stronger control, the separate OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium add-on expands the workflow with advanced activity review, dedicated IP and Blocklist tools, stronger fraud controls, and cloud-assisted fraud intelligence.

What the Premium add-on adds

OrderFort Fraud Shield Premium adds:

  • Dedicated Activity screen for reviewing suspicious and blocked events
  • Dedicated IP & Blocklist tools for better fraud visibility and control
  • Advanced protection controls for stores that need stronger filtering
  • Manual block management for IPs and other suspicious identities
  • Customer IP visibility and blocked-status visibility in order-related workflows
  • Cloud-assisted fraud signals for stronger real-time decision support
  • Shared fraud indicators through the OLTORA network for licensed Premium customers
  • Improved visibility into repeat fraud attempts across suspicious identities and order behavior

When stores need more visibility and control

The free version is designed to give WooCommerce stores a strong local starting point.

Premium is for merchants who want better visibility into suspicious behavior, more control over fraud review, stronger block management, and access to cloud-assisted fraud intelligence. It helps stores move from lightweight local protection to a more advanced workflow for monitoring, reviewing, and blocking suspicious activity.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip through WordPress or install it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open OrderFort Fraud Shield from the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Review the dashboard and protection data inside your WooCommerce workflow.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be active for OrderFort Fraud Shield to work.

Does the free version work on its own?

Yes. The free version provides lightweight local fraud scoring, essential checkout protection checks, and dashboard visibility without requiring the Premium add-on.

What does the Premium add-on include?

The Premium add-on expands the plugin with advanced activity review, dedicated IP and Blocklist tools, stronger fraud controls, and cloud-assisted fraud intelligence for merchants who need deeper visibility and tighter control.

Does the free version require an external account or cloud connection?

No. The free plugin is designed to work locally inside WordPress and WooCommerce.

Does this plugin read credit card numbers?

No. The plugin does not read or store raw payment card numbers or CVV/CVC values.

Will this slow down my WooCommerce store?

OrderFort Fraud Shield is designed to stay lightweight and practical for everyday WooCommerce use.
